name: 2SD882
description: NEC NPN medium-power transistor (marked 'D882') for ~3W audio output, regulators and relay/DC-DC drive. This is a TO-126 part, NOT a TO-92: the collector is the center pin and is bonded to the metal mounting tab. Complement to the 2SB772.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, marked face toward you)

pins.name: C
pins.description: collector (center, tied to the metal mounting tab)

TO-126.notes: TO-126 (rendered with the TO-220 template). Marked face toward you, leads down: E-C-B left to right. Collector is the CENTER pin and the tab. NEC numbers leads 1=E,2=C,3=B; some makers (Jiangsu Donghai) number them 1=B,2=C,3=E from the opposite end, but the physical layout is identical: identify the collector by the tab.

typical_application: Medium-power NPN for audio output (~3W), series-pass regulators, DC-DC converters and relay drivers; mount the tab to a heatsink for anything near its rating.
gotchas: this is a TO-126 (not TO-92); package, footprint and thermal handling are completely different
collector is the CENTER pin AND the mounting tab; watch for shorts to a grounded heatsink
datasheets number the outer leads in opposite directions; always find the collector by the tab, then read physical position (face toward you: E-C-B)
10W rating is at Tc=25C (heatsinked); without a heatsink it is only ~1W
